verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents single sign-on that lets users sign in to their company's cloud apps with their managed Google account, including a pre-integrated app catalog and custom SAML apps. That covers the 'sign in once' part of the story, but nothing in the evidence describes an employee-facing launcher dashboard or a browser extension for reaching assigned apps. Missing for 10: a documented employee app-launcher portal/dashboard, a browser extension for app access, per-user assigned-app visibility, and independent hands-on corroboration.
